title: Foundations of Computational Interaction
description: Foundations of Computational Interaction (v0.5.2, theory 0.5.0) is an interdisciplinary research program for formally describing, measuring, modeling, and predicting human-computer interaction. It contains the versioned knowledge system of record, empirical falsification protocols, and a C11 reference substrate for a deterministic subset of the ontology. Research corpus under CC-BY-4.0; code and schemas under Apache-2.0.
